description:
H1B GC and Citizens Only 
 
 Hi Friends, 
 Hope you are doing great, 
 
 I have an urgent requirement from one of my esteem client, I will appreciate if you can have an eye on the below requirement and send me your consultant updated profile ASAP. 
 
 Position title: Infrastructure Engineer 
 Location: Washington, DC (Local or Nearby Only) 
 Duration: 6-12 Months 
 
 The client has several initiatives that requires enhancements to the Test and Production environment infrastructure to support the NextGen Project. Looking for the candidate capable to work from day one to serve as a Lead and Technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) able to analyze, develop and implement an infrastructure strategy for existing Test environments for midrange and mainframe platforms. These environments comprise of Unit, Integration, Systems, and Acceptance Test and Production. 
 
 Tasks: 
 • Lead and provide technical direction and expertise to a project team . 
 • Provide daily technical support for the renovation of the existing environments. 
 • Analyze and recommend improvements to support Environment Management and Configuration Management process initiatives. 
 • Provide Production Environment and Infrastructure support for the Project. 
 • Support FTE SME’s in maintaining current (Test/Production) environments and infrastructure. 
 • Create all necessary documents and communicate to the team in support of the project. 
 • Provide pre-and post implementation support for Test and Production environments. 
 • Conduct training and knowledge transfer on new environments with FTEs. 
 
 Competencies: 
 1. Solid leadership and technical experience 
 2. Good Project management and ability to provide technical guidance to a team 
 3. The internal drive, intellectual curiosity, ability to learn, and desire to help the customers succeed 
 4. Strong technical skills 
 5. Comfortable working under Project Manager supervision 
 6. Ability to work proactively 
 
 Specific Required Skills: 
 a) Infrastructure engineer with a minimum of 10 years’ experience with: 
 a. Experience building robust test environments 
 b. Hands On Environment Infrastructure Build and Automation experience 
 c. Scripting and Automation experience 
 d. Build and Deployment experience 
 e. Database or DB2 Database experience 
 f. Extensive SDLC experience 
 g. Ability to analyze and trouble-shoot Mid-tier/Mainframe infrastructure issues. 
 
 Mid-tier/Mainframe platforms and their associated Operation Systems and Tools including: 
 a) WebSphere 
 b) MQ Series 
 c) Java/J2EE 
 d) DataPower 
 e) APIM 
 f) DB2 UDB 
 g) Strong UNIX/Shell Scripting 
 h) Python Scripting Preferred 
 i) AIX 


 If my requirement matches your resume, then please do reply on my email id alih (at) usmsystems(dot)com  and contact no is 703-955-3955
